items.title: Babe Stovall Interview, 1974-04-16
items.q: Played good. What did you hear him? Tommy Johnson.

ctx.x: No. No, it is. I've been to Sanctified Church, I've been to Church of God in Christ and all of you. Preacher plays guitar all of that. You two. Did you have any cousins that played any music? No. My nephews? Were you a young blonde? No, I was a brown. You were a brown. I was a brown. Jane Brown was my baby. I was a brown. I was a brown. I was a boy. I was a boy. I was a boy. I was a boy. Well, isn't there some sort of things to be kin to? Is it Babe or Tommy Johnson or somebody? All of Young's blood? Well, I…
Played good. What did you hear him? Tommy Johnson.
Oh, he came to talk with him. Right.
